tail:
**Batch 14 (`weak-elliptic-maximum-principles-and-holder-regularity` / `-examples`) — replay dispatch completed.**

Since the attempt-1 process had been paused before its exit receipt was recorded, I audited the existing artifacts from disk rather than rebuilding them: re-read design PDE-20 + its additions table and `plan-spec.json`, re-read all 31 manifest entries against their declared suppliers, re-ran the whole check suite, and re-validated every Step-1 record. Nothing in the A-page inventory, page edges, coverage, or sources needed changing; five genuine mathematical defects were found in B-page scaffold entries and repaired, with the seven affected items re-recorded.

**Repairs (all within owned artifacts)**
- `ex-weak-and-classical-...`: reversed integration-by-parts sign ($a_0=-4\int v\le0$) in the verification route.
- `cex-weak-maximum-principle-...`: 1D eigenfunction could not consume the batch-10 classical-to-weak lemma (needs $n\ge2$, $H^1_0$); moved to $(0,\pi)^2$, $u=\sin x_1$, $L=-\Delta-1$.
- `cex-harnack-requires-nonnegativity`, `cex-harnack-estimate-needs-an-additive-forcing-term`, `cex-global-harnack-comparison-needs-connectedness`: the same lemma was being applied to $u\notin H^1_0$; replaced by direct first-Green-identity/weak-gradient verifications and deps corrected (global item’s level 12→13 with the cited ball-chain lemma now declared).
- `cex-degenerate-ellipticity-...`: statement/counterexample mismatch ($u=x_2$ not nonnegative; matrix didn’t meet the stated hypothesis); now the positive-semidefinite false claim with nonnegative $u=|x_2|$ and the weak identity; stale unfetched `[PJ]` citation removed.
- `ex-measurable-coefficients-...`: 1D model also cited the $n\ge2$ De Giorgi–Nash theorem out of scope; rebuilt as the design’s piecewise-constant radial annulus example ($a\nabla u=x/|x|^2$ divergence-free, verified via published Gauss–Green).

**Checks (re-run after the repairs, recorded in the batch notes)**: `manifest-deps` 31/31 clean; `item-dependency-levels check` clean for batch 14 (only the 12 expected empty-inventory errors for unscaffolded batches 15–20); `content-policy --manifest-only` 665 items, 0 errors; `coverage-checklist` 2 pages/66 results clean; `source-fetch-check` 12/12 verified; `validate-plan` exit 0; `fwdcheck`/`extcheck` exit 0; `step1-decisions check` 665/665 ready; cross-batch input refreshed (33 rows, all edges reviewed, 0 orphans). Unresolved Step-3 authoring findings (forcing clause of the weak maximum principle, the $n=2$ level-set clause, Moser constants, supplier choice-ledger re-check) remain documented in the batch notes.
